2. Frog and Toad Series
   URL: https://toppsta.com/books/series/21369/frog-and-toad
   Channel: customize
   Content: Frog and Toad Series

(11 reviews)

Get ready for some pure nostalgia! This sweet classic picture book series about two amphibian friends will warm the cockles from the 1970s.

Each book in the series is a collection of five mini-stories of Frog and Toad's adventures together. From writing letters to going swimming, telling stories to finding lost buttons, Frog and Toad are always there for each other – just as best friends should be. This cosy series is also a lovely look at the small pleasures in life, like the first breezes of spring air, the sounds of baby birds and the wonder of sharing moments together.

The award-winning books are also now TV series available to watch on Apple TV.

Frog and Toad is a perfect series to add to your little library if you're a fan of Bear and Bird and Winnie-The-Pooh, and love stories of friendship, warmth and nature.

All the Frog and Toad books in order:

Book 1: Frog and Toad Are Friends (1970)
Book 2: Frog and Toad Together (1972)
Book 3: Frog and Toad All Year (1976)
Book 4: Days with Frog and Toad (1979)

With brilliant full-colour illustrations, this is a great first step after picture books or for newly independent readers, featuring a perfect princess who is actually ... an undercover hero!

Saving the world from horrible monsters day in, day out may not be your ordinary princess duties, but Princess Magnolia is always up for a challenge and is ready to switch into her superhero outfit at the first ring of her inconvenient monster alarm. This is a funny, action-packed series for young readers who like their princesses not only prim and perfect, but also dressed in black!

Shannon Hale  is also the author of Ever After High books and the Kitty-Corn books.
